mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, message, target_type, target_id, is_read, state, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, 0, 'normal', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS toastId, n.type, n.title, n.message, n.target_type AS targetType, n.target_id AS targetId, p.board_id AS boardId, n.is_read AS isRead, n.created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN posts p ON n.target_type = 'post' AND n.target_id = p.post_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.state = 'normal' AND n.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'normal' AND is_read = 0 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH)

SELECT n.notification_id AS toastId, n.type, n.target_type AS targetType, n.target_id AS targetId, p.board_id AS boardId FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN posts p ON n.target_type = 'post' AND n.target_id = p.post_id WHERE n.notification_id = #{toastId} AND n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.state = 'normal'
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'normal' AND is_read = 0 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(setting_value AS SIGNED) FROM policy_settings WHERE code = 'notification_list_months'
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET state = 'deleted' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'normal'
mapper.select: SELECT setting_value FROM policy_settings WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
